summary: KOSMOS is an educational video game developed using GDevelop to help high school students learn about space missions. Players design missions, manage resources, and make decisions.
details:
KOSMOS is an educational video game in which high school students can design and develop their own space missions. To do this, they must manage resources such as budget, mass, and energy, organize routes, and make decisions to achieve each mission's objectives.

This project offers a more practical and fun way to learn about science, engineering, and space exploration. Its goal is to spark young people's interest in technology and strengthen skills such as creativity, logical thinking, and problem-solving.

We developed the game using GDevelop, taking information from NASA and ESA space missions as references. Its creativity lies in turning space-related learning into an interactive experience where students learn while playing. We also considered making it educational, easy to understand, and accessible to high school students.

It also highlights the participation of students and educational institutions in space projects. This information is related to KOSMOS because our video game helps high school students understand these processes through mission creation, resource management, and decision-making. NASA offers educational games and activities that allow students to learn science in an interactive and fun way. These tools help students explore scientific concepts, develop creativity, and solve challenges. This resource is related to KOSMOS because both use video games as a different way to learn and spark young people's interest in science and space exploration.

NASA, through its Goddard Mission Design Lab, brings together engineers and specialists to design and plan space missions. This process considers aspects such as orbits, mass, energy, communications, and costs. This information is related to KOSMOS because our video game allows high school students to explore these same concepts by creating their own missions and making decisions to achieve their goals.

NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) develops methods to design and evaluate space mission concepts before carrying them out. This process considers feasibility, resources, costs, and different design options. It is related to KOSMOS because our video game allows high school students to experience these processes through mission planning and decision-making.
projectRefs: La Agencia Espacial Canadiense demuestra que los videojuegos y las actividades digitales pueden utilizarse como herramientas para enseñar sobre el espacio. A través de juegos interactivos, permite que los estudiantes conozcan las misiones espaciales, resuelvan desafíos y aprendan sobre la exploración del universo. Esto se relaciona con KOSMOS, ya que ambos buscan despertar el interés de los jóvenes por la ciencia y la tecnología mediante experiencias prácticas e interactivas.
